cond_0001.intro: The primary role of a Class 8 Clean Room Operator is to setup and operate equipment using established processes for the manufacture of medical components. Roles include but are not limited to: Assembly, Inspection, Testing. This person could work with manufacturing personnel, maintenance, quality assurance and technical teams.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Continuous flow operation, teaming up and cross training to learn any position in the cell and in the Cleanroom.
Continuously enhance assembly skills to contribute to efficient and high quality production.
Demonstrate proficiency in achieving production goals at each workstation.
Strive to exceed set production goals through dedication and focused work.
Collaborate with team members to optimize overall workflow and productivity.
Documenting activities accurately and completely.
Following sequences of operations in performing techniques such as assembly, inspection, testing and packing.
Use of precision tools on very small components.
Complying with FDA regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), general safety and manufacturing procedures, and company practices and policies.
Ability to read, comprehend and communicate in English.
Performs other related duties as assigned by management.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must possess fine motor skills
Ability to read standard and metric rulers and use a surgical blade
Ability to use magnification when needed (magnifiers, magnivisor, eyeloop)
High school diploma or general education degree (GED), or one to three months related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Computer skills: Inventory Software; Microsoft Outlook
Mechanically inclined, detail oriented, basic math skills
Preferred Requirements
Excellent teaming skills
Experience with QMS
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0111.intro: The primary role of a Class 8 Clean Room Operator is to setup and operate equipment using established processes for the manufacture of medical components. Roles include but are not limited to: Assembly, Inspection, Testing. This person could work with manufacturing personnel, maintenance, quality assurance and technical teams.
cond_0111.responsibilities:
Continuous flow operation, teaming up and cross training to learn any position in the cell and in the Cleanroom.
Continuously enhance assembly skills to contribute to efficient and high quality production.
Demonstrate proficiency in achieving production goals at each workstation.
Strive to exceed set production goals through dedication and focused work.
Collaborate with team members to optimize overall workflow and productivity.
Documenting activities accurately and completely.
Following sequences of operations in performing techniques such as assembly, inspection, testing and packing.
Use of precision tools on very small components.
Complying with FDA regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), general safety and manufacturing procedures, and company practices and policies.
Ability to read, comprehend and communicate in English.
Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

Minimum Requirements
Fine motor skills
Ability to read standard and metric rulers and use a surgical blade
Ability to use magnification when needed (magnifiers, magnivisor, eyeloop)
High school diploma or GED, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook
Mechanically inclined, detail oriented, basic math skills
Willingness to learn and openness to feedback when teaming with others
Preferred Requirements
Around one to three months of related experience and/or training, or equivalent
Familiarity with inventory software; background in QMS is a plus

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the assembly processes and technical steps involved.
cond_0139.responsibilities: Continuous flow operation, teaming up and cross training to learn any position in the cell and in the Cleanroom. Continuously enhance assembly skills to contribute to efficient and high quality production. Demonstrate proficiency in achieving production goals at each workstation. Strive to exceed set production goals through dedication and focused work. Collaborate with team members to optimize overall workflow and productivity. Documenting activities accurately and completely Following sequences of operations in performing techniques such as assembly, inspection, testing and packing. Use of precision tools on very small components Complying with FDA regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), general safety and manufacturing procedures, and company practices and policies Ability to read, comprehend and communicate in English Performs other related duties as assigned by management.
cond_0139.requirements: Must possess fine motor skills Ability to read standard and metric rulers and use a surgical blade Ability to use magnification when needed (magnifiers, magnivisor, eyeloop) Excellent teaming skills High school diploma or general education degree (GED), or one to three months related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Computer skills required: Inventory Software (experience with QMS preferred); Microsoft Outlook Other skills required: Mechanically inclined, detail oriented, basic math skills

cond_0256.intro: The primary role of a Class 8 Clean Room Operator is to setup and operate equipment using established processes for the manufacture of medical components. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the assembly processes and technical steps involved.

Documenting activities accurately and completely Following sequences of operations in performing techniques such as assembly, inspection, testing and packing. Ability to use magnification when needed (magnifiers, magnivisor, eyeloop)
Excellent teaming skills
Mechanically inclined, detail oriented, basic math skills
Computer skills: Microsoft Outlook

Inventory Software experience
Experience with QMS

cond_0341.intro: The primary role of a Class 8 Clean Room Operator is to set up and operate equipment using established processes for the manufacture of medical components. Roles include but are not limited to: Assembly, Inspection, Testing. This person will work with manufacturing personnel, maintenance, quality assurance and technical teams.
cond_0341.responsibilities:
Own continuous flow operation, cross training to learn any position in the cell and in the Cleanroom.
Drive assembly skill development to contribute to efficient and high quality production.
Demonstrate proficiency in achieving production goals at each workstation.
Execute production goals and push to exceed targets through dedication and focused work.
Lead coordination with team members to optimize overall workflow and productivity.
Document activities accurately and completely.
Execute sequences of operations in performing techniques such as assembly, inspection, testing and packing.
Use precision tools on very small components.
Ensure compliance with FDA regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), general safety and manufacturing procedures, and company practices and policies.
Ability to read, comprehend and communicate in English.
Performs other related duties as assigned by management.
cond_0341.requirements:
Must possess fine motor skills.
Ability to read standard and metric rulers and use a surgical blade.
Ability to use magnification when needed (magnifiers, magnivisor, eyeloop).
Excellent teaming skills.
High school diploma or general education degree (GED), or one to three months related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Computer skills required: Inventory Software (experience with QMS preferred); Microsoft Outlook.
Other skills required: Mechanically inclined, detail oriented, basic math skills.
